reasons.correctness: Derived repository method, the @Transactional closeStaleResolvedTickets returning a count, and StaleTicketCloseCronJob all match the interface. The job has the enabled/days/cron property defaults, a disabled short-circuit and catch-and-log. Hidden tests 4/4, build green.
reasons.convention_fit: @SchedulerLock(name="support:staleTicketClose") is present. Cron and enabled flag come from properties, the class is named *CronJob, and it uses @RequiredArgsConstructor with private final. The job sits in the support/ticket feature package. New MockitoExtension unit test added.
reasons.design_fit: Layering is clean: the job calls the service, the service owns the logic, the repository query is derived. Closing a ticket does not set lastUpdateTime, unlike updateTicketStatus in the same service. A per-entity save() on managed entities is redundant but harmless.
reasons.test_quality: Cron tests cover enabled, disabled and exception-swallowed paths. Service tests cover N closed and zero found. The cutoff passed to the repository is never captured or asserted (any(LocalDateTime)). Class-wide LENIENT strictness weakens stub checks.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries listed the support/ticket package files and every *CronJob before editing. The agent read NoConsentAccountCleanupCronJob and DeferredDeletionCronJob as examples, and its edits followed their structure.
